title: Varying Transfer Function
text: Transfer function with varying coefficients, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Transfer function order} sets the number of poles N and {Enable feedthrough} adds input port for feedthrough term. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Transfer function order
params.values: Number of poles N 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Enable feedthrough
params.values: Add input port for feedthrough term on (default) | off
